title: Recent Advances in Online Hate Speech Moderation: Multimodality and the Role of Large Models

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing literature that analyzes hate speech detection corpora for false positive biases against African American English.
Reviewing literature that evaluates model predictions for biases triggered by terms linked to stereotypical notions about women (e.g., 'dishwasher', 'broom').
Surveying studies that evaluate the tendency of detection models to generate false positives when encountering specific demographic or group identifier terms.
Reviewing quantitative analyses of how specific modalities (e.g., images) disproportionately influence model predictions in multimodal hate speech detection.
